|sellprice = 350 |edibility = -300 }} The '''Dinosaur Egg''' is an [[Artifacts|artifact]] and an [[Animals|animal product]]. Initially, a Dinosaur Egg can be found by digging up an [[Artifact Spot]] in [[The Mountain]]s (including the [[Quarry]]), in [[Fishing#Treasure Chests|Fishing Treasure Chests]] after reaching [[Fishing#Fishing Skill|Fishing level 2]] and having previously found at least one [[Artifacts|artifact]], dropped from a [[Pepper Rex]], foraged on [[Skull Cavern#Prehistoric Floors|Prehistoric Floors]] in the [[Skull Cavern]], or won in the Crane Game in the [[Movie Theater]]. Dinosaur Egg can also be gifted by a [[Animals#Pets|pet]] dog with max [[Animals#Friendship|friendship]]. Dinosaur Eggs can be put into an [[incubator]] in a [[Carpenter's Shop#Farm Buildings|Big or Deluxe Coop]] to hatch a [[Dinosaur]] ≈11 days later (≈6 days with the [[Farming#Farming Skill|Coopmaster Profession]]). Mature and fed dinosaurs will produce Dinosaur Eggs every 7 days. ==Donation== Donation of this item contributes to the total count of donations for the [[Museum]]. '''Tip:''' Placing the first Dinosaur Egg found into an incubator instead of donating it to the Museum will ensure that the player both obtains a Dinosaur and completes the Museum collection. ==Gifting== {{GiftsByItem |like=Dwarf,Penny,Demetrius,Alex |dislike=Robin,Maru,Sebastian,Linus,Pierre,Caroline,Abigail,George,Evelyn,Lewis,Clint,Pam,Emily,Haley,Jas,Vincent,Jodi,Kent,Sam,Leah,Shane,Marnie,Elliott,Gus,Wizard,Harvey,Sandy,Willy,Krobus,Leo }} ==Artisan Goods== :''See also: [[Animal Products Profitability]]'' Dinosaur Eggs can be used to make the following [[Artisan Goods|Artisan Good]]. {|class="wikitable roundedborder" !Image !Name !Description !Ingredient !Equipment !Time !Sell Price |- |[[File:Dinosaur Mayonnaise.png|center]] |[[Dinosaur Mayonnaise]] |{{Description|Dinosaur Mayonnaise}} |{{Name|Dinosaur Egg|1}} |style="text-align: center;" |[[File:Mayonnaise Machine.png|center|40px|link=]][[Mayonnaise Machine]] |{{duration|3 Hours}} |{{Price|800}} |} ==Bundles== Dinosaur Egg is not used in any [[bundles]]. ==Recipes== Dinosaur Egg is not used in any recipes. ==Tailoring== A Dinosaur Egg can be used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the {{Name|Dinosaur Hat|class=inline}}. It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as a green dye at the dye pots located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]]. It can also be used as a green dye when used in the spool of the Sewing Machine with a dyeable clothing item in the feed. ==Quests== *[[Quests#Gus' Famous Omelet|"Gus' Famous Omelet"]]: On the Special Orders board in front of the [[Mayor's Manor]], [[Gus]] may randomly request that the player collect and deliver 24 Eggs (of any type) to the fridge in [[the Stardrop Saloon]]. The reward is {{Price|3000}} and a [[Mini-Fridge]]. ==Secret== After hatching the first Dinosaur Egg, [[Demetrius]] will gift the player a [[Triple Shot Espresso]]. ==References== See AnimalHouse::adoptAnimal in the game code, and the entry for purchasedAnimal_Dinosaur in Characters/Dialogue/Demetrius.xnb in the data files. ==History== {{History|1.0|Introduced.}} {{History|1.4|Introduced [[Dinosaur Mayonnaise]] -- prior to this, putting Dinosaur Eggs into a [[Mayonnaise Machine]] resulted in gold-quality [[Mayonnaise]].
